There are three common methods for turning a bootstrap distribution
into a $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ confidence interval for a parameter $\param$
[@vittinghoff2e, Chapter 3; @efron1993introduction].
Each is an approximate
[confidence interval](inference.qmd#def-confidence-interval).
Throughout, $z_q$ is the $q$ quantile of the standard Gaussian distribution
and $\normcdf$ is its CDF.
